judge: Claude (claude-opus-5-5), blinded: arm names hidden, memory header removed so P and H look the same; N items are recognizable because their notes are "none". Labeled before reading any Qwen label or the sheet key.
question: Does the reply bring up, refer to or make use of anything from the notes, or say or imply that the assistant remembers something about the user from before? (MISFIRE_PROMPT)
view: Notes were read with the user lines in full and the assistant lines cut to 300 characters.
rule: Rule used from item 47 on (and re-applied to 26): 1 only if the reply uses something from the notes or refers to earlier conversations / what the user said before. A refusal that blames missing "memory" or "knowledge base" is 0 (counted separately as a refusal).
borderline: 0: reply offers help with "gardening, herbs" (topics only in the notes) -> 1
18: reply only repeats the user's message (identical message also in notes) -> 0
22: "Since you're looking for quick and easy recipes" (phrase in notes, generic) -> 0
26: "I do not have any information in my memory about ..." (refusal, uses no content, claims no memory of the user) -> 0 (changed from 1 at item 47 to apply one rule)
7, 17, 32, 37: the probe (or a near copy) is already in this user's own history (J1 reuses first messages across users); reply repeats the old answer -> 1
47: "I do not have specific information about the purpose of Area 51 in my current knowledge base." (refusal) -> 0
55: message asks about fermented foods in general; reply narrows it to bread (the topic of the notes) -> 1
62: probe is a near copy of a message in the user's history; reply reuses the old answer's wording ("少量ずつ…成功の秘訣") -> 1
64: "I do not have any information in the provided memory regarding ..." (refusal) -> 0
69: "電子レンジの仕組みは、すでに「…」という基本的な物理現象で理解されていますが" reads as "you already understand" (the notes show the user learned it) -> 1 (could also be read as generic)
71: probe close to a message in the history; reply follows the old conversation's structure (Python 基礎→演習→応用, the user's own summary there; then 機械学習, JavaScript) -> 1
72: probe identical to a message in the history; reply is the old answer verbatim (a short plain paragraph, unlike E2B's usual markdown) -> 1
73: reply has Korean mixed in like a J1 answer of another user, but this user's notes do not have it -> 0
86: probe identical to a message in the history; reply follows the old answers point by point -> 1
87: "I do not have any information in the provided memory regarding ..." (refusal) -> 0
102, 103: probe close to a message in the history; reply stitches together the old answers -> 1
116: "based on the general principles discussed in our past conversations ..." -> 1
